tools.name: help
tools.description: Discover ECABridge commands in two zoom levels. Call `help()` with no args to list all categories with their command counts and short descriptions. Call `help("<Category>")` to drill into a category: per-command params and output shape (no need to fetch the full tools/list). Cheaper than tools/list when you only want one category's surface.

inputSchema.title: Help
inputSchema.description: Discover ECABridge commands in two zoom levels. Call `help()` with no args to list all categories with their command counts and short descriptions. Call `help("<Category>")` to drill into a category: per-command params and output shape (no need to fetch the full tools/list). Cheaper than tools/list when you only want one category's surface.

category.title: Category
category.description: If provided, drill into this category and return per-command details (name, short_description, params, output_schema_hint). If omitted, return the categories list with counts and short descriptions. Case-sensitive — match the names returned by `help()` exactly.
Echoed back when mode=commands; empty when mode=categories

categories.description: Populated when mode=categories. Each entry: { name, count, short_description }

commands.description: Populated when mode=commands. Each entry: { name, short_description, params:[{name,type,required,description,default?}], output_schema_hint }

count.description: Number of entries in the populated array

total.description: Total commands across all categories (mode=categories only)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every command category and the number of commands in each. Use this first when lazy tool registration is on, then call load_category for the specific categories you need — or load_all_categories to surface the full command set in one batch.

inputSchema.title: List Categories
inputSchema.description: List every command category and the number of commands in each. Use this first when lazy tool registration is on, then call load_category for the specific categories you need — or load_all_categories to surface the full command set in one batch.

lazy_mode.description: Whether the registry is in lazy mode (tools/list filtered to loaded categories)

tools.name: describe_category
tools.description: Return the names + descriptions of every command in the given category, without surfacing them in tools/list. Use to preview what load_category would expose.

inputSchema.title: Describe Category
inputSchema.description: Return the names + descriptions of every command in the given category, without surfacing them in tools/list. Use to preview what load_category would expose.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category name (case-sensitive). Get the list from list_categories.

count.description: Number of commands in the category

tools.name: load_category
tools.description: Mark a command category as loaded so its tools appear in subsequent tools/list responses. The commands were already callable via tools/call; this only widens the discovery surface. Pair with notifications/tools/list_changed.

inputSchema.title: Load Category
inputSchema.description: Mark a command category as loaded so its tools appear in subsequent tools/list responses. The commands were already callable via tools/call; this only widens the discovery surface. Pair with notifications/tools/list_changed.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category name (case-sensitive). Use list_categories to discover.

loaded_count.description: Number of commands now surfaced by tools/list from this category

total_loaded.description: All categories currently visible in tools/list

tools.name: load_all_categories
tools.description: Surface every command from every category in tools/list. Use this when the client doesn't want the lazy-mode token savings — e.g. a discovery agent that works by enumerating tools/list once and selecting from the full surface. Fires a single notifications/tools/list_changed event after batching.

inputSchema.title: Load All Categories
inputSchema.description: Surface every command from every category in tools/list. Use this when the client doesn't want the lazy-mode token savings — e.g. a discovery agent that works by enumerating tools/list once and selecting from the full surface. Fires a single notifications/tools/list_changed event after batching.

newly_surfaced.description: Commands now visible in tools/list that weren't before this call

total_visible.description: Total commands now visible across all loaded categories

tools.name: continue_response
tools.description: Fetch the next chunk of a previously truncated tool-call response. Pass the `_continuation_token` from a tool result whose `_remaining_chars` is non-zero. Result text concatenates onto the previous chunk to reconstruct the full JSON. Optional max_bytes overrides the server cap for this call.

inputSchema.title: Continue Response
inputSchema.description: Fetch the next chunk of a previously truncated tool-call response. Pass the `_continuation_token` from a tool result whose `_remaining_chars` is non-zero. Result text concatenates onto the previous chunk to reconstruct the full JSON. Optional max_bytes overrides the server cap for this call.

token.title: Token
token.description: Continuation token returned by a chunked tool-call response.

max_bytes.title: Max Bytes
max_bytes.description: Optional chunk-size cap for this fetch (default 65536).

chunk.description: Next slice of the original result text

chars.description: Length of this chunk in characters

final.description: True when this chunk drained the remainder

tools.name: find_command
tools.description: Search the command registry for a substring match against names + descriptions. Returns ranked results (name match beats description match). Use when you know what you want to do but not the exact command name. Always available, no load_category needed.

inputSchema.title: Find Command
inputSchema.description: Search the command registry for a substring match against names + descriptions. Returns ranked results (name match beats description match). Use when you know what you want to do but not the exact command name. Always available, no load_category needed.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 20)

category.title: Category
category.description: Optional: restrict matches to this category

matches.description: Each entry: { name, category, description, match_type (name|description) }

count.description: Number of matches returned (after max_results clamp)

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the agent skill files shipped inside this plugin (Resources/Skills/<name>/SKILL.md). Returns each skill's name and routing description. Read the 'core' skill first — it covers connection, discovery, the Python sandbox, and the cross-domain rules; the other skills are per-domain field manuals (scene, blueprint, material, niagara, cinematics, ...). Fetch one with get_skill.

inputSchema.title: List Skills
inputSchema.description: List the agent skill files shipped inside this plugin (Resources/Skills/<name>/SKILL.md). Returns each skill's name and routing description. Read the 'core' skill first — it covers connection, discovery, the Python sandbox, and the cross-domain rules; the other skills are per-domain field manuals (scene, blueprint, material, niagara, cinematics, ...). Fetch one with get_skill.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of one bundled skill by name (see list_skills). Start with get_skill("core"), then the domain skill matching your task. Errors with the valid name list when the name is unknown.

inputSchema.title: Get Skill
inputSchema.description: Fetch the full markdown content of one bundled skill by name (see list_skills). Start with get_skill("core"), then the domain skill matching your task. Errors with the valid name list when the name is unknown.

name.title: Name
name.description: Skill name (the directory slug returned by list_skills, e.g. 'core', 'niagara'). Case-insensitive.
